items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Harold Christoff and myself and a guitar player.

ctx.x: like weddings and stuff like that. They have weddings and things like that, banquets and

things up in there too. Well that's the most that they have. They don't have no dances there, no big dances. And since these big halls, they opened up now, these new halls, but they don't have nowhere else to go but them new halls. They have everything in them one halls. They don't have nowhere for the Dixieland bands to play because it don't take. It don't take no more. It takes some time in the country. Like we played a dance carnival night in Shell Beach. That's way down. Well they had a lot of people there…
